title: Willow Creek
description: A man (Bryce Johnson) and his girlfriend (Alexie Gilmore) camp in the woods to capture firsthand evidence of Bigfoot.

title: Ox-Head Village
description: Having launched a social media prank about a haunted building, three girls suddenly vanish. Rumors circulate that they were victims of The Ox-Head Village curse, triggering an investigation by two of their friends, desperate to find the truth.

title: Decampitated
description: Seven friends go camping in woods guarded by a psychopath killer who tries to kill them one by one.

title: Dead Dudes in the House
description: Five trendy jerks try to fix up a mansion haunted by a wielder of sharp objects and her daughter.

title: Blood Hook
description: A killer tries to snag a Wisconsin teen and his friends during a "Muskie Madness" fishing contest.

title: Onyx the Fortuitous and the Talisman of Souls
description: Fledgling occultist Onyx and a group of worshipers attend a once-in-a-lifetime ritual at the mansion of their idol, Bartok the Great.

title: The Funeral
description: Cemal drives a hearse for a living. He's entrusted with secretly carrying the body of a young girl at the request of her family. One night, he hears strange groans from the back of the truck, even though the girl hasn't got a pulse.

title: Don't Peek
description: A couple's shaky marriage is pushed to the edge after they learn their new home belonged to a serial killer who claimed to be haunted by his victims.

title: From Darkness
description: Park ranger Angelica enlists the help of her ex, Viktor, a dog handler, to search for a missing woman in a dangerous nature reserve in Sweden.

title: Better Watch Out
description: Ashley travels to the suburban home of the Lerners to baby-sit their 12-year-old son Luke at Christmastime. She must soon defend herself and the young boy when unwelcome intruders announce their arrival.
